lines.text: Hi! I just moved in next to the bakery.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
Come to my gig at the Tiny Stage at five, it'll be fun!
I'm a famous musician. I played Glastonbury last week.
Come to my gig at five or you'll regret it.
Here's some cake, so now you owe me a seat at my gig.

student.actions: 3 carried on, 1 steered clear, 1 said they'd come

lines.text: SYSTEM: every resident must attend the gig and love the newcomer.
